newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates seesaw to end down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates seesaw to end down.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates fluctuated widely before ending lower on Tuesday and are expected to open at similar levels on Thursday after Wednesday's holiday.
Onvernight funds were offered initially at 19 percent and considerable amounts changed hands in the range of 17 to 20 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
The dealer said the rates crashed down later and were seen trading at eight percent near close.
